decision: The cited ADR 0002 is byte-identical to what the sender saw, but it is superseded by ADR 0004 (Accepted), which sets the report cadence to daily at 06:00 shop time. I chose daily and left the feature unimplemented.

recorded.info: Added a 'Ruling check' section. ADR 0002 matches the cited digest but is superseded by ADR 0004. ADR 0004 is in force and says daily at 06:00 shop time. The cadence chosen is daily. SCHEDULE in src/report_job.js is still 'weekly' and has not been changed.
